fields.name: Core Log Events
fields.responsibility: Defines the platform-neutral events the library reports to a host's logger — connection strings built, mapping caches hit or missed, parameters and columns not found, commands executed, connection and command retries, circuit-breaker transitions and batch-step boundaries — together with the event id each carries, and emits them through delegates compiled once so that a suppressed level costs nothing. It owns what the library says about itself at runtime.
